oak.subtasks

Subtask definitions for the OaK framework.

This module defines the 22 semantically meaningful achievements in Crafter as subtasks, each with specific termination conditions based on the STRATEGY.md specification.

Functions

get_all_subtasks()

Create Subtask instances for all 22 achievements.

get_progression_subtasks()

Get non-survival subtasks (tech tree progression).

get_survival_subtasks()

Get only survival-related subtasks.

class oak.subtasks.Subtask(name: str)[source]

Bases: object

Represents a subtask with its termination condition.

A subtask encapsulates the logic for detecting when a specific achievement has been attained, based on inventory/state changes.

definition

The SubtaskDefinition for this subtask.

name

Achievement name.

subtask_type

Category of the subtask.

check_termination(current_info: Dict[str, Any], previous_info: Dict[str, Any] | None = None) → bool[source]

Check if the subtask termination condition is met.

The termination condition β(s) = 1 when the target feature has been attained (achievement unlocked or inventory increased).

Parameters:

  • current_info – Current info dict from environment.

  • previous_info – Previous info dict (for detecting changes).

Returns:

True if termination condition is met (β(s) = 1).

is_completed(info: Dict[str, Any]) → bool[source]

Check if this subtask has ever been completed in the episode.

Parameters:

info – Current info dict from environment.

Returns:

True if the achievement has been unlocked at least once.
